families.name: Recognition
families.definition: Attaching semantic labels and identities to what is in the image: category, instance, part, attribute, material, state, action, text and symbol. The question it answers is *what is this*.

families.name: Reconstruction
families.definition: Recovering geometric and photometric scene/image properties: projected 2D spatial arrangement, depth, distance, metric size, orientation, curvature, 3D pose and shape, illumination, and geometry hidden by an occluder. The question it answers is *what is the geometric scene or its projection like*.

families.name: Reorganization
families.definition: Organising visual elements into coherent structures without necessarily naming them: grouping and segmentation, correspondence, ordering, counting, localization, and connection/topology. The question it answers is *what goes with what and how is it organised*.

tasks.name: Object editing
tasks.definition: Add objects of a requested category or replace existing objects with that category in the input image.

tasks.name: Attribute editing
tasks.definition: Change a specified color, material, or other appearance attribute in the input image.

tasks.name: Category recognition
tasks.definition: Recognize the semantic category, name, stable identity attribute, or known identity of an object, person, place, or scene.
include: which object, species, vehicle, place, or scene category is shown
identifying a named landmark, person, brand, logo, or individual instance
verifying that a named category or known instance is present
coarse age group, gender, race, or another stable semantic attribute
semantic query-candidate retrieval by shared class or concept, without same-instance mapping
exclude: naming a component of a larger object -> i2t:PART_RECOGNITION
transcribing a written name -> i2t:OCR_TEXT
mapping the same entity across indexed images/frames -> i2t:CORRESPONDENCE_TRACKING
inferring an irreducible purpose or social situation -> i2t:HOLISTIC_SCENE_UNDERSTANDING
named colour, material, texture, typeface, or visual style -> i2t:COLOR_MATERIAL
a conventional instruction or state conveyed by an icon, sign, or legend -> i2t:SYMBOL_LEGEND
country or territory identity encoded by a national flag -> i2t:SYMBOL_LEGEND
an ordinary transient or operational state -> i2t:STATE_EMOTION
a visible action, sport, activity, or gesture being performed -> i2t:ACTION_RECOGNITION
projected 2D shape or outline class -> i2t:COLOR_MATERIAL
generic matching by overall visual resemblance -> i2t:VISUAL_SIMILARITY
tasks.decision_test: Is the answer a semantic category or identity rather than a visual match, temporary state, activity, or grounded region map?
tasks.routing_axis: a semantic class, stable class attribute, proper name, or known-instance identity

tasks.name: Part recognition
tasks.definition: Identify or name a sub-part / component of an object (a handle, a wing, an engine bay).
include: which part of the object is indicated
whether a named part is present or intact
exclude: counting parts -> i2t:OBJECT_COUNTING
pointing at where the part is -> i2t:REFERENTIAL_LOCALIZATION
tasks.decision_test: Is the required name specifically a component of a larger object?
tasks.routing_axis: the semantic name/identity of a component within a larger object

tasks.name: Appearance understanding
tasks.definition: Understand visible appearance in the image plane, including named non-geometric properties and projected 2D shape, silhouette, outline, contour morphology, or edge structure.
include: the colour, material, texture, finish, pattern, typeface, or visual style that is shown
a comparison along a named appearance property such as darker, rougher, sharper, or blurrier
projected 2D shape, silhouette, perimeter, outline class, indentation, or contour morphology
an image-plane intensity, texture, outline, silhouette, or edge field
exclude: overall image or object resemblance without a named property or explicit outline request -> i2t:VISUAL_SIMILARITY
an explicit localized mapping of a point, patch, part, or entity across indexed images or frames -> i2t:CORRESPONDENCE_TRACKING
illumination, shadow, reflectance separation, or light direction -> i2t:LIGHTING_SHADING
intrinsic observer-independent 3D solid form or physical surface bending -> i2t:THREE_D_SHAPE_REASONING
a causal boundary where one physical surface occludes another -> i2t:OCCLUSION_BOUNDARIES
normative abnormality, defect, forgery, or manipulation -> i2t:ANOMALY
semantic object or scene category, or known identity -> i2t:CATEGORY_INSTANCE
a target point, box, mask, crop, polygon, or foreground support -> i2t:REFERENTIAL_LOCALIZATION
real-world size, distance, or other metric geometry -> i2t:METRIC_3D_RELATION
tasks.decision_test: Is the requested variable a named visible property or projected 2D shape/contour/edge representation, rather than holistic resemblance, 3D form, or localized cross-image identity mapping?
tasks.routing_axis: a named visible appearance property or projected 2D shape, contour, or edge field

tasks.name: Visual similarity
tasks.definition: Judge holistic visual resemblance, difference, or match among complete images, regions, or objects when no localized indexed correspondence and no specific appearance property is requested.
include: choosing which complete image or candidate looks most like a reference overall
ranking or comparing several images by overall visual similarity
generic resemblance, difference, or appearance-based retrieval without a named property
overall visual change when no explicit point, patch, part, or entity must be mapped
exclude: a named property or projected shape, silhouette, contour, or edge representation -> i2t:COLOR_MATERIAL
an explicit localized mapping of a marked point, patch, part, or entity across indexed images or frames -> i2t:CORRESPONDENCE_TRACKING
semantic matching by object or scene category -> i2t:CATEGORY_INSTANCE
abnormality, defect, forgery, or manipulation relative to a standard -> i2t:ANOMALY
metric size, distance, or physical geometry -> i2t:METRIC_3D_RELATION
tasks.decision_test: Is the requested relation an overall image/object resemblance or ranking, rather than an explicit localized cross-image correspondence?
tasks.routing_axis: holistic image/object resemblance without a localized indexed mapping

tasks.name: State recognition
tasks.definition: Recognize an ordinary temporary, operational, environmental, or emotional state without judging it against a norm.
include: emotion, facial expression, mood, weather, time of day, or on/off state
open/closed, wet/dry, cooked/raw, awake/asleep, or another ordinary state contrast
active traffic-signal or device status even when that status is encoded by colour
a present or predicted non-normative state value
exclude: diagnosis, severity, defect, compliance, or deviation from normal -> i2t:ANOMALY
naming an action or interaction -> i2t:ACTION_RECOGNITION
inferring a multi-entity social situation, affordance, or purpose -> i2t:HOLISTIC_SCENE_UNDERSTANDING
a stable semantic or demographic class such as age group, gender, or race -> i2t:CATEGORY_INSTANCE
literal hue, texture, typeface, or style independent of function -> i2t:COLOR_MATERIAL
tasks.decision_test: Is the answer a temporary state, including emotion, rather than a stable category, activity, or anomaly?
tasks.routing_axis: an ordinary temporary, operational, environmental, or emotional state

tasks.name: Activity understanding
tasks.definition: Understand what activity or event is happening, how it develops, or which semantic stage of an activity or process is shown.
include: what a person, animal, or object is doing
which interaction or visible event is occurring
how an ongoing visible event develops or what happens next
the semantic order or stage of an activity or process
exclude: whole-situation relationship, purpose, intent, affordance, safety, or narrative meaning -> i2t:HOLISTIC_SCENE_UNDERSTANDING
recovering an externally shuffled visual permutation from continuity -> i2t:GLOBAL_ORDERING
geometric heading, gaze, body configuration, or surface orientation without an action label -> i2t:SURFACE_ORIENTATION
performance quality scored against a normative reference -> i2t:ANOMALY
a stable profession, role, or semantic entity class -> i2t:CATEGORY_INSTANCE
an ordinary state or emotion without an action label -> i2t:STATE_EMOTION
tasks.decision_test: Is the answer what activity or event is happening, how it develops, or which activity/process stage is shown, rather than what the whole situation means?
tasks.routing_axis: the visible activity/event, its development, or its semantic process stage

tasks.name: Anomaly detection
tasks.definition: Detect whether an observation departs from what is normal, correct, authentic, healthy, intact, or properly performed.
include: whether a component, behaviour, condition, or scene is abnormal or defective
whether an image is manipulated, forged, AI-generated, or otherwise inauthentic
grading how well an action or performance meets an explicit or learned standard
quality, severity, or deviation scores whose meaning is normative rather than descriptive
exclude: assigning an ordinary non-normative state value -> i2t:STATE_EMOTION
a generic visual difference without a normal/abnormal judgement -> i2t:VISUAL_SIMILARITY
recognizing the visible action/event or its semantic stage without judging quality -> i2t:ACTION_RECOGNITION
prospective safety or affordance requiring whole-scene context -> i2t:HOLISTIC_SCENE_UNDERSTANDING
counting anomalous instances after they have been identified -> i2t:OBJECT_COUNTING
predicting how a visible event develops or what happens next -> i2t:ACTION_RECOGNITION
tasks.decision_test: Must the observation be judged against an expected norm or reference standard?
tasks.routing_axis: departure from a normal, correct, authentic, healthy, or quality standard

tasks.name: Situation understanding
tasks.definition: Understand what a whole situation means by combining multiple entities and contextual cues, including relationships, purpose, intent, affordance, safety, and narrative meaning.
include: the overall purpose or intended use of a scene or setting
a latent social or ecological relationship such as kinship, competition, predation, or symbiosis
an affordance or safety judgement requiring the complete scene context
meme, caption, poem, or narrative alignment when the answer is the whole situation's meaning rather than an activity or event sequence
exclude: a visible action or event, how it develops, or an activity/process stage -> i2t:ACTION_RECOGNITION
one object or scene category, main subject, or known instance -> i2t:CATEGORY_INSTANCE
one ordinary state, mood, or emotion -> i2t:STATE_EMOTION
one direct spatial or topological relation -> i2t:QUALITATIVE_SPATIAL_RELATIONS
one conventional sign or icon meaning -> i2t:SYMBOL_LEGEND
a rule or state transition decoded from a structured display -> OUT_OF_SCOPE
a normative quality or anomaly judgement about an observed performance -> i2t:ANOMALY
dense per-pixel semantic class assignment -> i2t:SEMANTIC_SCENE_PARSING
tasks.decision_test: Does the answer express what the whole situation means—such as a relationship, purpose, intent, affordance, safety judgement, or narrative—rather than what activity or event is happening or how it develops?
tasks.routing_axis: the relationship, purpose, intent, affordance, safety, or narrative meaning of the whole situation

tasks.name: OCR and text recognition
tasks.definition: Reading written text, numbers, handwriting, or mathematical expressions rendered in the image, and verifying that a given string is present.
include: what does the sign / label / handwriting say
transcribing an equation or a number printed in the image
whether the stated text appears in the image
directly transcribing text or numbers inside a chart, table, diagram, or interface when no structural inference is needed
exclude: reasoning over chart/table structure, encoded quantities, or abstract rules -> OUT_OF_SCOPE
a non-text pictogram -> i2t:SYMBOL_LEGEND
a semantic class, genre, or identity inferred after reading text -> i2t:CATEGORY_INSTANCE
counting visible text instances rather than transcribing them -> i2t:OBJECT_COUNTING
tasks.decision_test: Must written characters, numbers, handwriting, or an expression be transcribed or verified?
tasks.routing_axis: a literal written character sequence or expression

tasks.name: Symbol recognition
tasks.definition: Recognize the conventional meaning of a non-text symbol, icon, pictogram, traffic sign, flag, map key, or legend item.
include: what an icon, traffic sign, road marking, or pictogram means
which country or territory a national flag conventionally represents
which series a legend colour refers to
the conventional instruction encoded by one sign, arrow, or symbolic marking
exclude: locating the symbol -> i2t:REFERENTIAL_LOCALIZATION
brand or known-instance identity conveyed by a logo -> i2t:CATEGORY_INSTANCE
a traffic rule or affordance inferred from several scene cues -> i2t:HOLISTIC_SCENE_UNDERSTANDING
the geometric pointing orientation of one arrow without interpreting its instruction -> i2t:SURFACE_ORIENTATION
multi-element chart, diagram, interface, or abstract-pattern reasoning -> OUT_OF_SCOPE
tasks.decision_test: Must one non-text symbol or legend item be recognized or decoded?
tasks.routing_axis: the conventional meaning of one non-text symbol

tasks.name: Region semantic recognition
tasks.definition: Connect semantic concepts to image regions by assigning class labels to pixels or regions across the image.
include: semantic segmentation of the full image
the semantic class at a specified pixel or region
choosing or interpreting a category-labelled mask or parsing map
exclude: localizing one referred target without assigning semantic classes across the image -> i2t:REFERENTIAL_LOCALIZATION
class-free 2D grouping or matting -> i2t:REFERENTIAL_LOCALIZATION
geometry-driven 2.5D grouping -> OUT_OF_SCOPE
the category or identity of one object or scene without region grounding -> i2t:CATEGORY_INSTANCE
scene purpose, intent, narrative, or social situation -> i2t:HOLISTIC_SCENE_UNDERSTANDING
tasks.decision_test: Must semantic labels be grounded to pixels or regions across an image, rather than merely naming one entity or locating one referent?
tasks.routing_axis: semantic class labels grounded to pixels or image regions

tasks.name: Colorization
tasks.definition: Recover the color image corresponding to a grayscale input.

tasks.name: Z-depth
tasks.definition: Predict camera-axis z-buffer depth for each visible image location.

tasks.name: Euclidean depth
tasks.definition: Predict Euclidean distance from the camera to the visible surface at each image location.

tasks.name: Surface normals
tasks.definition: Predict the local three-dimensional surface-normal direction at each image location.

tasks.name: Principal curvature
tasks.definition: Predict local principal surface curvature from the input image.

tasks.name: Occlusion edges
tasks.definition: Predict image boundaries caused by occlusion and visible depth discontinuities.

tasks.name: 3D keypoints
tasks.definition: Predict a predefined representation of three-dimensional keypoints or landmarks.

tasks.name: Reshading
tasks.definition: Recover the image's per-pixel shading representation from its visual content.

tasks.name: Inpainting
tasks.definition: Complete rectangular masked regions of an input image.

tasks.name: Lighting understanding
tasks.definition: Illumination, shading, shadows, highlights, reflectance vs. illumination (intrinsic-image) reasoning, and light-source direction.
include: where the light comes from; which surface is in shadow
separating an object's true colour/albedo from the light falling on it
whether a shadow / reflection / highlight is physically consistent
exclude: the object's intrinsic colour with no illumination question -> i2t:COLOR_MATERIAL
surface normal, slant, or plane orientation rather than illumination -> i2t:SURFACE_ORIENTATION
tasks.decision_test: Is illumination, shading, shadow, highlight, reflectance separation, or light direction the target?
tasks.routing_axis: an illumination, shading, shadow, reflectance, or light-direction property

tasks.name: Depth understanding
tasks.definition: Recover camera-relative depth or depth order: z/radial distance from the observer, including pairwise front/behind and nearer/farther order along the viewing direction when no physical metric is requested.
include: dense or sparse camera-relative depth
which scene point or object is nearer to or farther from the camera
whether one visible entity is in front of or behind another in camera depth
ordinal or categorical depth layers without a real-world distance scale
exclude: real-world inter-object distance, physical size, height, length, or scale -> i2t:METRIC_3D_RELATION
a directly visible image-plane left/right, above/below, centre, side, corner, or quadrant relation -> i2t:RELATIVE_3D_RELATION
actual visibility blocking, crop indeterminacy, or a causal occlusion boundary -> i2t:OCCLUSION_BOUNDARIES
an entity's facing, heading, articulated configuration, or a surface orientation -> i2t:SURFACE_ORIENTATION
touching, containment, attachment, support, or another topological relation -> i2t:QUALITATIVE_SPATIAL_RELATIONS
tasks.decision_test: Is the requested variable ordered distance along the camera/viewing axis, rather than image-plane x-y position or real-world metric distance?
tasks.routing_axis: camera-relative z/radial depth or front/behind order

tasks.name: Metric 3D relation
tasks.definition: Recover a real-world metric or scale-bearing relation among scene entities: inter-object distance, physical proximity, size, height, length, volume, or quantitative 3D layout.
include: how far one physical entity is from another
which entities are physically closer together or farther apart, even when the answer is a qualitative distance bin
which object is physically larger, taller, longer, nearer to another, or farther from another
metric scene dimensions or scale-consistent layout
exclude: front/behind or nearer/farther order relative to the observing camera -> i2t:DEPTH_DISTANCE
a directly visible projected left/right, above/below, frame position, or image-plane proximity relation -> i2t:RELATIVE_3D_RELATION
a count after applying a metric-distance filter -> i2t:OBJECT_COUNTING
a named non-geometric appearance property -> i2t:COLOR_MATERIAL
intrinsic 3D form independent of metric size or scale -> i2t:THREE_D_SHAPE_REASONING
generic visual resemblance or matching -> i2t:VISUAL_SIMILARITY
heading, facing, door swing, relative axis alignment, or surface orientation -> i2t:SURFACE_ORIENTATION
touching, attachment, containment, support, overlap, or path connectivity -> i2t:QUALITATIVE_SPATIAL_RELATIONS
tasks.decision_test: Does the answer describe physical distance or size in the scene—numerically or categorically—rather than projected image position or camera-axis depth order?
tasks.routing_axis: a real-world physical distance, size, or scale relation among entities

tasks.name: Occlusion understanding
tasks.definition: Determine whether content is visible, occluded, cropped, or out of frame; recover the occluder/occluded order and causal boundary where one surface blocks another.
include: whether an object or part is fully visible, partly hidden, cropped, or indeterminate
which surface physically occludes another
where an occluding contour or causal depth discontinuity runs
exclude: front/back camera-depth order without actual visibility blocking -> i2t:DEPTH_DISTANCE
reconstructing pixels inside a masked or missing region -> OUT_OF_SCOPE
an untyped 2D edge or projected outline without an occlusion cause -> i2t:COLOR_MATERIAL
tasks.decision_test: Does the item ask about visibility loss from blocking or image-boundary truncation, or about the causal occlusion boundary, rather than plain depth, inpainting, or 2D shape?
tasks.routing_axis: visibility status, occluder/occluded order, or a causal depth boundary

tasks.name: 3D shape reasoning
tasks.definition: Reason about intrinsic 3D form that is independent of the observer, including solid identity, congruence, cross-section, folding and unfolding, or local surface bending such as curvature, ridges, and valleys.
include: which solid or net matches an object
whether two solids are congruent under rotation
the cross-section produced by slicing or folding a solid
whether a surface is convex, concave, flat, raised, or indented
where a local ridge, valley, crease, or curved region runs
exclude: a requested camera projection, top/side view, or view transform -> i2t:MULTIVIEW_VIEWPOINT_REASONING
a semantic object name -> i2t:CATEGORY_INSTANCE
real-world size, distance, length, volume, or scale -> i2t:METRIC_3D_RELATION
a projected 2D outline, perimeter indentation, or edge map -> i2t:COLOR_MATERIAL
surface slant, normal, heading, facing, or articulated pose -> i2t:SURFACE_ORIENTATION
tasks.decision_test: Is the requested variable an observer-independent global 3D form or local way a physical surface bends, rather than a projection, scale, or orientation?
tasks.routing_axis: observer-independent global or local 3D form, including surface bending

tasks.name: Orientation understanding
tasks.definition: Understand the orientation or geometric configuration of a focal entity or visible surface, including heading, facing, gaze, articulated pose, door opening or swing direction, object rotation, relative axis alignment, surface normal, slant, tilt, or slope.
include: which way a person, animal, vehicle, object, arrow, door, or movable part faces, points, opens, or swings
gaze, head direction, articulated body or limb configuration, and rigid object rotation
upright/inverted state, heading, or orientation relative to camera or world axes
whether physical entities or axes face, point, travel, align, or oppose one another
surface normal, slant, tilt, road slope, or ground-plane orientation
exclude: a directly visible left/right, above/below, frame position, quadrant, or other image-plane arrangement -> i2t:RELATIVE_3D_RELATION
the semantic action or meaning expressed by a configuration -> i2t:ACTION_RECOGNITION
camera pose or a transform between viewpoints -> i2t:MULTIVIEW_VIEWPOINT_REASONING
touching, containment, support, overlap, or path/topological connectivity -> i2t:QUALITATIVE_SPATIAL_RELATIONS
the conventional instruction conveyed by an arrow or sign -> i2t:SYMBOL_LEGEND
illumination, shadow, or light direction rather than surface geometry -> i2t:LIGHTING_SHADING
explicit 2D keypoint coordinates or maps -> i2t:LANDMARKS_JUNCTIONS_2D
explicit 3D landmark coordinates or maps -> OUT_OF_SCOPE
intrinsic observer-independent global or local 3D form -> i2t:THREE_D_SHAPE_REASONING
a count or proportion of visible elements having an orientation -> i2t:OBJECT_COUNTING
tasks.decision_test: Is the requested variable how an entity, articulated part, physical axis, or surface is oriented or configured, rather than where it lies in projected image x-y coordinates?
tasks.routing_axis: the orientation or geometric configuration of an entity, articulated part, axis, or surface

tasks.name: 2D spatial relation
tasks.definition: Understand a directly visible, qualitative spatial relationship in the projected image plane, including position relative to the frame or to another visible entity, without inferring physical depth, metric geometry, or 3D orientation.
include: left/right, above/below, top/bottom, centre, side, or corner position in the image
one visible entity's projected left/right or above/below position relative to another
row, column, quadrant, image-plane order, or projected alignment
which visible item is closest to an image edge, corner, or centre
qualitative projected proximity or separation when no physical depth or real-world distance is required
exclude: touching, attachment, containment, support, overlap, intersection, shared carrier, path, or graph connectivity -> i2t:QUALITATIVE_SPATIAL_RELATIONS
front/behind, nearer/farther from the camera, or another camera-axis depth order -> i2t:DEPTH_DISTANCE
real-world distance, size, height, length, volume, or scale, including categorical physical-distance comparisons -> i2t:METRIC_3D_RELATION
heading, facing, gaze, articulated configuration, door swing/opening direction, axis alignment, or surface orientation -> i2t:SURFACE_ORIENTATION
visibility loss because one surface blocks another -> i2t:OCCLUSION_BOUNDARIES
intrinsic observer-independent 3D form or local surface bending -> i2t:THREE_D_SHAPE_REASONING
camera motion, view transformation, requested projection, or novel-view integration -> i2t:MULTIVIEW_VIEWPOINT_REASONING
a count or comparison of counts after applying a spatial predicate -> i2t:OBJECT_COUNTING
an ambiguous, broken, non-visual, abstract, or primarily semantic item with no clear supported capability -> OUT_OF_SCOPE
tasks.decision_test: Can the answer be read as a qualitative relation in image x-y coordinates, without recovering depth, physical scale, or how an entity or surface is oriented in 3D?
tasks.routing_axis: a directly visible qualitative x-y position or arrangement in the image plane

tasks.name: Multi-view reasoning
tasks.definition: Transform or integrate camera/observer coordinate frames: camera motion/pose, requested projection, novel view, multi-view layout, or egocentric navigation.
include: how the camera moved between indexed views
which top, side, or novel projection a scene/solid produces
integrating multiple views or choosing an egocentric turn
exclude: intrinsic solid identity, net, congruence, or cross-section -> i2t:THREE_D_SHAPE_REASONING
an entity's or surface's pose/orientation in the observed frame -> i2t:SURFACE_ORIENTATION
only matching a point/entity across views -> i2t:CORRESPONDENCE_TRACKING
metric relation without a requested view transform -> i2t:METRIC_3D_RELATION
tasks.decision_test: Must the answer explicitly transform or integrate observer/camera frames or produce a requested projection?
tasks.routing_axis: a camera/observer-frame transform or integration

tasks.name: Semantic segmentation
tasks.definition: Predict a fixed semantic category label for every image pixel or region.

tasks.name: 2D edges
tasks.definition: Predict local image-plane edges induced by visible texture and intensity structure.

tasks.name: 2D keypoints
tasks.definition: Predict a predefined representation of two-dimensional image keypoints.

tasks.name: 2D segmentation
tasks.definition: Partition an image into class-free coherent regions using two-dimensional appearance cues.

tasks.name: 2.5D segmentation
tasks.definition: Partition visible surfaces into class-free regions using image and 2.5D geometric cues.

tasks.name: Object pointing
tasks.definition: Given an image and a category query, overlay one point on every matching visible instance.

tasks.name: Jigsaw
tasks.definition: Recover the correct spatial organization of shuffled image regions or patches.

tasks.name: Localization
tasks.definition: Mark the region of an input image matching a referring expression.

tasks.name: Localization
tasks.definition: Return, select, or evaluate the image support of a target—point, box, crop, mask, polygon, foreground region, or 2D segmentation—regardless of whether the target is an object, part, text, symbol, or interface element.
include: object or part detection and referring-expression grounding
locating text, symbols, labels, document fields, icons, controls, or map features
selecting or evaluating a target point, box, mask, crop, polygon, or foreground region
class-free foreground/background or 2D region segmentation whose output is spatial support
estimating how much image area a referred visible object occupies
exclude: a predefined 2D keypoint representation -> i2t:LANDMARKS_JUNCTIONS_2D
dense semantic class assignment over pixels -> i2t:SEMANTIC_SCENE_PARSING
a directly visible relative image-plane position between entities -> i2t:RELATIVE_3D_RELATION
contact, containment, support, overlap, or path/topological connectivity -> i2t:QUALITATIVE_SPATIAL_RELATIONS
reading an exact alpha intensity at one queried pixel -> OUT_OF_SCOPE
reasoning over an encoded quantity, rule, or interface transition -> OUT_OF_SCOPE
naming a semantic object part without returning its spatial support -> i2t:PART_RECOGNITION
tasks.decision_test: Is the requested variable where or how extensively a target occupies the image, including its point/box/mask/foreground support, rather than one pixel's numeric alpha value?
tasks.routing_axis: the point, extent, mask, foreground support, or class-free 2D segmentation of a target

tasks.name: Connectivity
tasks.definition: Understand whether entities, regions, or graph elements are connected through contact, attachment, containment, support, overlap, adjacency, intersection, a shared carrier, or a traversable path.
include: touching, attached, intersecting, overlapping, adjacent, or disconnected
containment, support, membership, and inside/outside topology
path, road, wire, curve, graph, or region connectivity and reachability
maze routes, connected components, and whether entities share a carrier or surface
exclude: directly visible left/right, above/below, frame position, row/column, quadrant, or projected alignment -> i2t:RELATIVE_3D_RELATION
front/behind or nearer/farther order along the viewing direction -> i2t:DEPTH_DISTANCE
real-world distance, size, length, or scale -> i2t:METRIC_3D_RELATION
heading, facing, gaze, door swing, articulated configuration, or physical-axis orientation -> i2t:SURFACE_ORIENTATION
one target point, box, crop, mask, polygon, or foreground support -> i2t:REFERENTIAL_LOCALIZATION
semantic labels assigned densely to pixels or regions -> i2t:SEMANTIC_SCENE_PARSING
dense geometry-based region partition -> OUT_OF_SCOPE
tasks.decision_test: Is the invariant who touches, contains, supports, overlaps, connects, or is reachable from whom, rather than projected position, depth, distance, or orientation?
tasks.routing_axis: contact, containment, support, overlap, connection, or reachability topology

tasks.name: Counting
tasks.definition: Count a visually selected set, compare set cardinalities, or derive a fraction, proportion, or percentage from visibly identifiable instances, parts, regions, marks, or text elements.
include: how many visually selected objects, people, parts, regions, marks, or text instances exist
which visible set contains more, fewer, most, or least elements
what fraction, proportion, or percentage of a visible set satisfies a visual predicate
exclude: reading a number that is written in the image -> i2t:OCR_TEXT
decoding a quantity represented by a chart axis, bar, gauge, or table -> OUT_OF_SCOPE
measuring real-world size, length, or distance -> i2t:METRIC_3D_RELATION
reporting an entity or surface orientation without aggregating a set -> i2t:SURFACE_ORIENTATION
tasks.decision_test: Is the final quantity obtained by selecting and aggregating visible instances rather than transcribing text, decoding an encoded display, or measuring physical geometry?
tasks.routing_axis: a count, cardinality comparison, or proportion derived from a visually selected set

tasks.name: 2D Ordering
tasks.definition: Recover the original permutation of externally shuffled visual units using spatial or visual continuity.
include: jigsaw tile or patch reassembly
ordering shuffled crops, panels, or views from continuity
recovering the original visual sequence after explicit permutation
exclude: the original order of an explicitly shuffled sequence is not requested -> OUT_OF_SCOPE
one directly visible pairwise or frame-relative image-plane position -> i2t:RELATIVE_3D_RELATION
camera motion or geometric view transformation -> i2t:MULTIVIEW_VIEWPOINT_REASONING
tracking the same entity through time without recovering a permutation -> i2t:CORRESPONDENCE_TRACKING
a semantic event or activity sequence without an explicit shuffle -> i2t:ACTION_RECOGNITION
tasks.decision_test: Were visual units externally permuted, and is the requested output the restoring permutation rather than an event label?
tasks.routing_axis: the permutation that restores a coherent visual whole

tasks.name: 2D keypoints
tasks.definition: Recover a predefined image-plane keypoint representation: corners, junctions, salient points, or 2D landmarks.
include: detecting corners, T-junctions, or salient 2D keypoints
choosing or predicting a 2D keypoint map
localizing predefined anatomical or structural keypoints in image coordinates
exclude: localizing an arbitrary referred object, text, control, or region -> i2t:REFERENTIAL_LOCALIZATION
matching a keypoint across images or frames -> i2t:CORRESPONDENCE_TRACKING
